context_no-partitions: There are no partitions to display
context_heavy-hitters: Keys that take a noticeable part of the input of their partition. More partitions cannot split such a key, a dominating one requires a change of the grouping key.
context_window: 'now' is the latest measurement, '30 s' and '10 min' are exponential averages with the corresponding half-life
context_single-window: The metric is always averaged over the heavy-hitters window of the computation, 5 minutes by default
context_cpu-usage: CPU used by the job of a partition and its companion process.
context_memory-usage: Heap held by the job of a partition and its companion process.
context_messages-per-second: Messages read from the input streams of a partition; zero for computations without input streams.
context_bytes-per-second: Bytes read from the input streams of a partition; zero for computations without input streams.
